source: https://ehds.ghs.gov.gh/declaration (form steps and the length checks in its loaded scripts, read 2026-11-18 in a browser). Only length limits were readable; the form was not submitted.

document_number.label: Passport or ID number
document_number.help: The form takes a passport, a national ID card or another document, and its number must be 2 to 30 characters.

errors.invalidFormat: 2 to 30 characters, as printed on the document

flight_number.label: Flight number
flight_number.help: For arrivals by air, up to 20 characters. The form's own example is KQ 512. Land and sea arrivals get vehicle or vessel fields instead.

email.label: Email (optional)
email.help: Optional, up to 254 characters. The form also asks for a phone number and how Port Health can reach you.
